Good product thinking starts with understanding the problem space. That's why I designed my portfolio like an EHR, to put you directly in it: the clunky interfaces, fractured workflows, and cognitive overload that clinicians, nurses, and patients navigate during care delivery. This is my way of highlighting healthcare's most expensive problem while showcasing the analytical work I do to improve patient care and workflows within it
